text: I want to find out how long passenger boarding takes on average. Create an event log containing the start and end of passenger boarding for each boarding session.

For each aircraft turnaround, reconstruct the actual ground-handling process from the start of overall ground-handling coordination until the aircraft is ready. Keep different types of work distinct and include their actual start and completion so I can examine how jobs progress and overlap.

For each outbound flight, show the final departure-preparation milestones so I can compare elapsed intervals between boarding and actual off-block. Include only boarding start and close, confirmed closure of the baggage loading operation, aircraft readiness and actual off-block.

Where is time lost during aircraft turnarounds? For each turnaround, reconstruct the actual process from inbound landing to outbound take-off, including arrival movements, the overall start of ground handling, the actual start and completion of every ground service, boarding start and close, aircraft readiness, and departure movements.

For each turnaround, include the overall start of ground handling, the actual start and completion of cabin cleaning and refuelling, and aircraft readiness. I want to compare cleaning and refuelling durations and see how these jobs overlap during preparation.
I want to understand how long it takes to get a flight away once boarding starts. For each outbound flight, include boarding start and close, actual off-block departure and take-off.

For each outbound flight, compare the order and timing of selected ground-service completion milestones during the turnaround that prepared it. Include only completion of baggage unloading from the arriving aircraft, cabin cleaning, refuelling, catering loading and confirmed closure of baggage loading.
Trace the actual aircraft movements from arrival to the next departure for each turnaround. Include only arrival and departure movement milestones, from inbound landing to outbound take-off.
How long do departures following a turnaround take from leaving the stand to take-off? Create an event log of actual off-block and take-off events.

I want to review the boarding-to-departure sequence for each flight on each operating date, without grouping flights that share the same flight number. Include boarding start, boarding close and actual off-block departure for each outbound flight.
I'd like to compare boarding durations across boarding sessions. Create an event log of the session-level boarding lifecycle, rather than individual passengers' boarding actions.

How does boarding progress into take-off for departures following a turnaround? Build an event log containing only flight-level boarding milestones and actual departure movements, from the beginning of boarding to take-off.
